claims.finding: An 8-K carrying ONLY item 8.01 (Other Events) was filed on 2026-08-13, three weeks before the print, and it is referenced nowhere in the 22-item pre-print news sweep, nowhere in the 150-item first sweep, and nowhere in the social stream - a standalone Other Events filing at a company three weeks from results is either a strategic announcement, a settlement or a disclosure the company wanted separated from the earnings release.
claims.corpus_ref: filings.json, 8-K dated 2026-08-13 with items '8.01' - the most recent filing of any kind before the print
claims.why_not_priced: Item 8.01 has no standard interpretation, which is exactly why aggregators skip it, and this capture ran a 22-query news sweep on the morning of the print without surfacing a single August company announcement. The sign is genuinely uncertain - I lean negative because it sits between two 13D/A amendments (2026-07-20 and 2026-08-03) at a company whose board has just been changed - but the informative fact is that a material standalone disclosure exists and no observed coverage discusses it.
claims.independence: Two SCHEDULE 13D/A amendments bracket it (2026-07-20 and 2026-08-03), a separate filing series showing a >5% holder actively repositioning in the same weeks - https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001397187&type=SC+13D

claims.finding: The founder's proxy campaign appears to have changed the board: a PREC14A nominated Laura Gentile, Eric Hirshberg and Marc Maurer as Class I directors on a GOLD universal proxy card, the 2026 annual meeting produced an 8-K carrying items 5.02 AND 5.07 on 2026-06-26, and three days later on 2026-06-29 two Form 3s and eleven Form 4s were filed at once - i.e. new insiders seated on the board immediately after the vote.
claims.corpus_ref: docs/a6714b8a9efb77fcb23338c7664926c08439b598.txt (snapshots/20260903T151408Z.json item 19); filings.json 8-K dated 2026-06-26 items '5.02,5.07', two Form 3s and eleven Form 4s dated 2026-06-29, DEFA14A dated 2026-06-05
claims.why_not_priced: The proxy fight was covered; the outcome, read off the filing pattern, was not - no item in the news sweep reports who won, and the only mention of Chip Wilson is inside an undated SWOT piece. A reconstituted board and a new chief executive arriving together is the standard precondition for a guidance reset and a write-down quarter, and that is the mechanism the price has not discounted while it rallied 5.9% into the event.
claims.independence: The corpus separately records the leadership half of the same reset from independent sources - Calvin McDonald announcing his departure on the December 2025 third-quarter call and Heidi O'Neill's appointment being sold off as a 'vote of no confidence': https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/261815035-lululemon-lulu-stock-heidioeill-ceo-succession-nike-china-growth-tradingkey

claims.finding: The fundamentals going into the reset are already deteriorating on the company's own numbers: the corpus captures 'Lululemon cuts 2026 forecast as sales slump across Americas', a separate analysis titled 'Lululemon Q1 FY2026: The Brand Is Still There.
